# CG Cookie

> > CG Cookie is a comprehensive learning platform offering structured Blender courses, tutorials, and community-driven training for 3D artists at all skill levels.

The platform specializes in Blender education, covering topics from beginner fundamentals to advanced techniques in Geometry Nodes, Retopoflow 4, and the latest Blender versions (4.5 LTS and 5.0). Led by experienced instructors including Spencer Magnuson, Wayne, Kenny, and Ton, CG Cookie provides membership-based access to courses with instructor feedback and a supportive community for aspiring and professional 3D artists.

## Key Topics

- Blender
- Blender 3D 4.5 LTS
- Blender 5.0
- Geometry Nodes
- Retopoflow 4
- 3D Modeling
